grandline.boss.enraged: %s has lost all patience! Every blow hits harder and comes faster.
grandline.boss.foresight_broken: %s reels: their foresight is broken for a few seconds!
grandline.boss.clash.hold: Your Conqueror's Haki meets %s's head-on, and holds! They stagger.
grandline.boss.clash.overwhelmed: Your Conqueror's Haki clashes with %s's... and is overwhelmed.
grandline.boss.moves_on: %s steps past you to face the others. Get back up, or let your friends get you up.
grandline.boss.defeated.death: %s has fallen. You were there when it happened.
grandline.boss.defeated.yield: %s yields: you have bested one of the strongest people on the sea!
grandline.boss.defeated.arrest: %s is in seastone cuffs, taken by your side!
grandline.boss.reward.law: The bounty on their head is yours: %s Beli for bringing down %s.
grandline.boss.relic.lore: Taken from %s. There is no other.
grandline.boss.cuffs_resist: %s is still far too strong to cuff. Beat them down first.
grandline.tooltip.haki_scroll: A great fighter's notes on their Haki. Read it to awaken that Haki, or to train it a good deal.
grandline.haki_scroll.awakened: The notes make sense of something that was always in you: your %s Haki awakens!
grandline.haki_scroll.trained: You study the notes until dawn. Your %s Haki grows stronger.
grandline.haki_scroll.no_trait: The notes describe a will you were not born with. You learn what you can from them about Armament instead.
boss.grandline.relic.hrolf.desc: An iron club the height of a mast, worn smooth by a hundred harbours' worth of grateful hands.
boss.grandline.relic.kurogane.desc: Its studs are dice. Every one of them shows a six.
boss.grandline.relic.barnum.desc: It still hums a carousel tune when it swings.
boss.grandline.relic.aurelia.desc: A blade that catches the first light of morning and keeps it.
boss.grandline.relic.constance.desc: The Fleet Admiral's sword. It has never once been lowered.
boss.grandline.relic.zenith.desc: A rapier so bright it casts no shadow at noon.
boss.grandline.relic.nadir.desc: Light bends a little around it, and never quite comes back.
boss.grandline.relic.meridian.desc: Still warm. They will always be warm.
boss.grandline.relic.sterling.desc: A gilded flintlock with a price engraved under the barrel. Yours, now.
boss.grandline.relic.hisui.desc: A war bow strung with serpent sinew. It never misses what it is proud of.
boss.grandline.relic.jinpachi.desc: The Last Blade's other sword, the one he never needed to draw. Until you.
boss.grandline.relic.leonhart.desc: Static crackles between the knuckles. They smell faintly of rain.
boss.grandline.relic.saltmarsh.desc: A Warlord's dress sword, crusted with salt that never washes off.
boss.grandline.relic.lucrezia.desc: A rapier of mirrored steel. Your reflection in it is always a little late.
boss.grandline.relic.pipistrello.desc: A tiny Warlord's enormous spear. The point still turns on its own.
boss.grandline.relic.nox.desc: A thin blade that leaves a faint purple haze where it has been.
boss.grandline.relic.vespera.desc: A whip of braided string, finer than hair and stronger than chain.
boss.grandline.relic.sigrun.desc: A glaive wrapped in blue flame that warms and never burns its bearer.
boss.grandline.relic.hagane.desc: A Wano blade with a dragon chased along its spine. The dragon's eyes follow you.
boss.grandline.relic.aldric.desc: A long, thin sword that ticks very softly in its scabbard.
boss.grandline.relic.morwenna.desc: A staff of white wood. Holding it, you feel briefly older, then younger.
boss.grandline.relic.cassius.desc: The ground hums whenever it is set down.
boss.grandline.relic.ottavia.desc: Pale blue, cold to the touch, and nothing has ever made a scratch on it.
boss.grandline.relic.leopold.desc: Its tines drip with mud from no sea anyone has charted.
boss.grandline.hrolf.phase2: HAH! Now you've woken me up properly! Elbaph, give me room!
boss.grandline.hrolf.phase3: Calloway would have liked you. That's why I won't hold back. Not even a little!
boss.grandline.kurogane.phase2: You raised the stakes. Good. Let's see you cover the bet.
boss.grandline.kurogane.phase3: All in. Everything on the table, rookie. The house always wins.
boss.grandline.barnum.phase2: The second act! Lights, music, and a brand-new attraction: YOU!
boss.grandline.barnum.phase3: The grand finale! Nobody leaves the Midnight Carnival. NOBODY!
boss.grandline.aurelia.phase2: Ha! Now that's a fight! The stars are coming down to watch!
boss.grandline.aurelia.phase3: He told me the sea would send someone like you. Show me the dawn, kid!
boss.grandline.constance.phase2: You are strong. Strength changes nothing. The tide does not bend.
boss.grandline.constance.phase3: Then I will drown you in justice myself.
boss.grandline.zenith.phase2: Ohh, how tiring. I suppose I'll have to go at the speed of light.
boss.grandline.zenith.phase3: High noon. No shadows anywhere. Where will you hide?
boss.grandline.nadir.phase2: You're still standing. How loud of you.
boss.grandline.nadir.phase3: Come down here with me. Everything ends at the bottom.
boss.grandline.meridian.phase2: So you're one of the ones worth taking seriously. The sea boils for you.
boss.grandline.meridian.phase3: I'll sort out which side of the line I'm on later. Burn.
boss.grandline.sterling.phase2: The scales tip. Everything you have just got heavier.
boss.grandline.sterling.phase3: Final judgement! I'm cashing in every debt you never knew you owed!
boss.grandline.hisui.phase2: You have impressed me. Now be afraid of what impresses me.
boss.grandline.hisui.phase3: Eight heads, and every one of them furious. Kneel, or be devoured!
boss.grandline.jinpachi.phase2: There. That is what your sword was missing. Now you have it, keep it.
boss.grandline.jinpachi.phase3: I will show you the last cut. Watch closely. You will see it only once.
boss.grandline.leonhart.phase2: GARUUUU! An honest fight! Zou, hear the thunder!
boss.grandline.leonhart.phase3: Look up, outsider. The moon is full tonight.
boss.grandline.saltmarsh.phase2: Thirsty? Let me dry you out properly.
boss.grandline.saltmarsh.phase3: I will grind you to salt and sell you by the pinch!
boss.grandline.lucrezia.phase2: You smudged my mirror. Do you have any idea how rude that is?
boss.grandline.lucrezia.phase3: Every reflection on this island hates you now, darling.
boss.grandline.pipistrello.phase2: You hit a WARLORD?! The audacity! The INSOLENCE! Drills, rise!
boss.grandline.pipistrello.phase3: Small? SMALL?! I'll show you the biggest drill in the world!
boss.grandline.nox.phase2: You're making this personal. I did ask you not to.
boss.grandline.nox.phase3: Breathe deep. It's the last thing this island will give you.
boss.grandline.vespera.phase2: Your shadow is fighting me. How irregular. I'll stitch it down.
boss.grandline.vespera.phase3: The cage is closing. Nobody leaves the board until I say so.
boss.grandline.sigrun.phase2: So you will be standing when the sun rises. Then rise with it!
boss.grandline.sigrun.phase3: A phoenix does not fall. It burns, and it begins again.
boss.grandline.hagane.phase2: You draw steel in my capital? Then see the Azure Dragon!
boss.grandline.hagane.phase3: Thunder, fire and wind: all of Wano's sky answers to me!
boss.grandline.aldric.phase2: Untidy. You have stayed in the record far too long.
boss.grandline.aldric.phase3: Let me show you what twenty years feel like.
boss.grandline.morwenna.phase2: Zeus, Prometheus. Teach this child to kneel.
boss.grandline.morwenna.phase3: Your soul is not yours, child. It never was.
boss.grandline.cassius.phase2: Islands have broken under smaller grudges than this.
boss.grandline.cassius.phase3: Then the island will tilt, and the sea will come for you!
boss.grandline.ottavia.phase2: Your price just went up. You still cannot afford it.
boss.grandline.ottavia.phase3: Nothing touches what I have paid for. Nothing touches me.
boss.grandline.leopold.phase2: The sea lanes are closed to you. Sink.
boss.grandline.leopold.phase3: The swamp has no bottom, little sailor. I have looked.
